description: This file defines the 'Translation' model class in the Opencart framework, responsible for retrieving translation records from the database based on a given route.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A model class that provides methods to interact with translation data in the database within the design namespace.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves translation entries for a specific route from the database, filtered by store ID and language ID.
